acceptance: SFTP supports direct and script-relay modes; defaults to read-only and preserves AI visibility and write controls.

UI save/edit/download/probe works; no user data or running production instance modified.
scope: Source configuration/credentials, SSH ProxyCommand bridge, downloaded Python agent, UI/localization, focused integration tests and docs.

requirements.summary: User confirmed a downloadable script on a device with access to the SFTP service; not an SSH jump-host feature.
evidence: User confirmation: 是，通过脚本中转连接 SFTP（推荐）

design.summary: Pinned TLS/challenge tunnel carries existing OpenSSH/SFTP protocol to one embedded target. Independent relay key; original SSH host and authentication unchanged.

implementation.summary: SFTP direct/relay choice; separate fixed-target TLS bridge, authenticated downloadable script/probe, OpenSSH ProxyCommand and independent third credential field with partial-update preservation.

verification.summary: 21 top-level focused Go race tests passed, including real generated-agent SSH/SFTP password/key authentication, listing/read/write, read-only denial, wrong relay identity, stale deployment and SSH host-key change. Existing relay regression and vault partial/locked/malformed tests passed. Node UI regression and quick gate passed. Safari fixture: probe, list/read, unlock, editor save, actual SFTP target file readback, relock and disabled Save, source editor configuration/blank-secret retention verified. Windows remote-agent execution and real external SFTP deployment NOT_RUN. Additional ~4 MiB actual SFTP write/readback race test passed.

documentation.summary: Deployment steps, endpoint/probe semantics, SSH identity preservation, read/write policy and API fields documented.

cleanup.summary: Only owned Safari test tab closed; user tab/form and live 9999 instance preserved. Disposable fixture container stopped; test logs/screenshots retained. No global Docker cleanup or user-data changes.
evidence: Browser returned to unchanged user localhost:9999 source form

release.summary: Prepare PR against main; no admin exception, merge, publication or production deployment authorized for this feature.

handoff: SFTP downloadable-script relay implemented and actual protocol/Safari fixture verified. Production localhost:9999 is unchanged; use PR review and current-head CI before merge/deploy. Windows remote relay and external real-host SFTP acceptance not run.
